UKSSSC Group C Driver Result 2026 - Complete Details

UKSSSC Group C Driver Result 2026 released on 02 June 2026. Download UKSSSC Driver Hall Ticket for Written Exam on 21 June 2026. Check direct download link, steps and important instructions here.

Important Dates

  • Start Date : 17/04/2026
  • Last Date : 07/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 07/05/2026
  • Correction Last Date : 11-13 May 2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 31/05/2026
  • Answer Key Objection Date : 03-07 June 2026
  • Result Declare Date : 19/06/2026
  • Download Admit Card : Click Here
  • Download Admit Card Notice : Click Here

Application Fee

  • Start Date : 17/04/2026
  • Last Date : 07/05/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 07/05/2026
  • Correction Last Date : 11-13 May 2026
  • General / OBC : Rs. 300/-
  • SC / ST / EWS : Rs. 150/-
  • Post Name : Total Post

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
